title: Do delivery drones replace workers?
summary: A case study of drone delivery at SF Express and Meituan, based on a visit to SF's drone testing site and interviews with technicians and couriers.
finding: Drones made couriers' work easier rather than replacing them. The bigger obstacle is policy, such as the lack of public landing sites.

title: China's divorce cooling-off period and domestic violence
summary: An analysis of Article 1077 of China's Civil Code, which adds a 30-day waiting period before a divorce can proceed.
finding: The waiting period can keep women and children facing domestic violence in danger. I proposed two reforms in a 3-page submission to the NPC Standing Committee's Legislative Affairs Commission.
